card.name: Issue numbers in journal citations
card.fires_on: Digits and the opening bracket for the issue number in a journal reference, right after the volume, e.g. 'Oceania 39 (3): 198'. Also fires on the ellipsis placeholder after the 'modifications will be sent to our editors' notice.

modes.label: Issue number in citation
modes.description: The issue number in brackets after a journal volume, before the page range.

modes.label: Encyclopedia edit notice
modes.description: The placeholder after a 'submit your modifications to our editors' notice, just before the article text begins.
